steps.title: Build and preview a page in two minutes
items: 3 · Edit in Layout, Content and Split view

steps.caption: Open the folder for your page, click **New** › Page, name it and click **Create**
The editor opens in **Layout** view: the page the way visitors will see it

steps.name: Templates
steps.caption: Start from a template: open **Panels** › Templates
The template adds a hero, an image and body copy, styled with the site design

steps.in: The case for a slow morning
steps.caption: Edit right on the page: double-click a word and type
Switch to **Content** view to see the structure behind the page
Each block is a table: its name sits in the header row, like **hero**
You can edit here too. Change the eyebrow text…
**Split view** shows Layout and Content side by side
Edit on the right and watch the page update on the left
Ready to share? Click **Send**, keep **Preview** selected and click **Update**
Your page is on the preview site: **{previewHost}**
